name: schedule-extractor
description: Extract plant legends and material schedules from construction/landscape drawings — a PDF, or images (photos/screenshots) of sheets — into an Excel workbook (one sheet per detected schedule).
when_to_use: Use when the user attaches a construction, landscape, or site PDF, or one or more images of a drawing sheet or schedule table, and asks to pull plant legends, material schedules, planting tables, or similar tabular schedules out of them into a spreadsheet. Images may be photos or screenshots of a whole sheet (the schedule is located and cropped out automatically) or of just the table. Pass every schedule image in one call via input_files — they all land in one workbook, one sheet per schedule. Do NOT use for free-text questions, or for drawings with no schedule/legend tables.

input_files.description: Handles of the attached files to process, e.g. ["file_1", "file_2"]. Each must be one of the file handles listed in the conversation. One PDF, or one or more images; pass all the schedule images the user sent in a single call rather than calling once per image.

input_file.description: Single-file shorthand for input_files, e.g. "file_1". Use input_files when there is more than one.

ignore_first_column.description: Drop the first table column (often a column of plant symbols/codes rather than data). Set false to keep it.

skip_pages.description: Zero-based page indices to skip in a PDF (e.g. cover sheets). Empty means scan every page. Ignored for images.

output: An .xlsx workbook with one sheet per detected schedule — named "Page N, Schedule M" for a lone PDF, or after the source image/page when several files are processed — plus a short text summary of how many schedules were found.
